meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin during Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **rich, fragrance-free moisturizer with ceramides + humectants** (like glycerin or hyaluronic acid). Winter’s lower humidity can weaken the skin barrier and increase dryness. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹356*

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()
*₹208*

### [Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra-Nourishing Cream]()
*₹629*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

**🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
Excellent if your skin is **very dry, flaky or tight**. It contains three ceramides and hyaluronic acid, is fragrance-free, and has a richer cream texture suited to dry/very dry skin. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best value/everyday option: Cetaphil DAM**  
A particularly good choice if you want something **rich but not excessively heavy**. Cetaphil specifically recommends its Advanced Relief/DAM-type moisturizers for winter dryness, with ingredients such as shea butter, glycerin and panthenol. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Best for very dry/sensitive skin: Bioderma Atoderm**  
A nourishing option if your skin gets **rough, uncomfortable or easily irritated** in winter.

**💰 Good Indian-brand alternative: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid**  
Worth considering if you want a ceramide-based moisturizer at a generally lower price than imported options.

### If I had to choose just one
**CeraVe Moisturising Cream** for very dry skin.  
**Cetaphil DAM** if you want something a little lighter and more economical.

Apply it **within a few minutes after washing while your skin is still slightly damp**—this helps retain moisture. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-ceramide-moisturizer-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹300/₹500/₹1,000)** and whether this is **for your face or body**, I can narrow it down to the best 2–3 options available in India.
